law_record.title: Stopping, standing or parking outside of business or residence district (1)
law_record.text: Upon any highway outside of a business or residence district no person shall stop, park or leave standing any vehicle, whether attended or unattended, upon the paved or main-traveled part of the highway when it is practicable to stop, park or so leave such vehicle off such part of the highway, but in every event an unobstructed width of the highway opposite a standing vehicle shall be left for the free passage of other vehicles and a clear view of such stopped vehicles shall be available from a distance of 200 feet in each direction upon such highway. This section shall not apply to the driver of any vehicle which is disabled while on the paved or main-traveled portion of a highway in such manner and to such extent that it is impossible to avoid stopping and temporarily leaving such disabled vehicle in such position.

activation_conditions: the subject stops, parks or leaves a vehicle standing on the paved or main-travelled part of a highway
the highway is outside a business or residence district
it is practicable to leave the vehicle off the travelled part
exceptions: a vehicle disabled on the travelled part in such manner that it is impossible to avoid stopping and temporarily leaving it there
residue: 'business or residence district' is a legal region class — a reading assumption
'practicable' is a judgement element about the available off-road space
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the width and the 200-foot clear view must hold for the whole time the vehicle stands
'temporarily' bounds the disabled-vehicle exception; the bound must be declared
